description: This source file defines the DashboardScreen widget for a Flutter application, displaying a financial overview including total expenses and a category breakdown pie chart. It includes UI components, state management, data fetching from a transaction repository, and rendering of chart visualizations.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main dashboard view, showing total expenses and categorization chart.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the dashboard's dynamic data, UI updates, and interactions.

methods.name: _load
methods.description: Fetches total expenses and category breakdown data for the selected month from the repository.

methods.name: _legend
methods.description: Generates a list of widgets serving as the legend for the category breakdown pie chart.

methods.name: _buildPie
methods.description: Constructs the pie chart visualization based on category data.

methods.name: _sliceColors
methods.description: Provides a fixed list of colors used for pie chart slices.
